title: HR Operation Senior Specialist
description:
【Responsibilities】

1. HR Policy Enablement & Governance：

Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.

Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.

Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.


2. HR Process Standardization & Optimization:

Design, document, and continuously improve HR processes to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are well-integrated and operationally sound.

Establish clear workflows and guidelines for employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, probation and internal mobility, etc..


3. Quality Controal & Employee Experience：

- Ensure seamless execution of HR policies to improve employee experience and operational efficiency.

- Provide training and communication on policy updates and process changes to HR teams and managers.

- Conduct periodic audits to verify adherence to HR policies and recommend corrective actions where needed.

- Implement a quality audit framework to regularly assess HR operations, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.


【Requirements】

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.

- 5+ years of experience in HR operations, policy management, or process governance within an international organization.

- Strong knowledge of HR policy frameworks, compliance, and global employment regulations.

- Experience in developing and implementing HR SOPs and process documentation.

- Proficiency in HR technology solutions and data-driven decision-making.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


【Highlights】

- Be a driver in creating HR policies in a rapidly growing global company.

- Influence decision-making by implementing scalable HR frameworks that will define future operations.

- Work with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies to develop global HR policies while ensuring local compliance.

- Gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of international HR operations in a fast-scaling business.

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality audits to enhance HR service delivery.

title: Application Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Application Project Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


Job Description:

The Application Project Manager will drive the delivery and management of IT applications throughout their lifecycle. This role is essential to ensure the effectiveness, security and innovation of the applications, contributing to the overall technological advancement and operational efficiency of the organization. The professional must possess a distinct combination of business, IT, financial, and communication skills.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Project Management: Developing detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Ensure the timely and successful delivery of IT projects, meeting defined goals and expectations.
  • Leadership and People Management: Lead and inspire project teams, promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Provide support, guidance, and mentorship to team members, encouraging their professional growth.
  • Stakeholder Management: Developing and maintaining strong relationships with all project stakeholders, ensuring that their needs and expectations are understood and managed effectively.
  • Resource Management and Budget: Allocate and manage resources effectively to ensure project delivery within scope, deadline, and budget constraints. Develop and manage the project budget, seeking to optimize expenses and minimize the total cost of ownership.
  • Supplier and Contract Management: Collaborate and negotiate with suppliers, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure successful completion.
  • Quality Assurance and Compliance: Implement rigorous testing and quality assurance protocols. Ensure that all project activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, and organizational policies.


Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 11 to 15 years of experience. More than 10 years of experience in IT project management with a focus on application development and deployment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Tools: Proficiency in project management software such as MS Project, Jira, Trello . Knowledge of reporting and analysis tools to track metrics and project performance.
  • Methodologies: Familiarity with project management methodologies such as PMI, PRINCE2 and Agile approaches.

Soft Skills:

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Leadership: Strong leadership qualities to guide and motivate teams.
  • Conflict Resolution: Proficiency in identifying and resolving conflicts through effective mediation and negotiation techniques.
  • Negotiation Skill and Influence: Effective negotiation skills for dealing with contracts. Ability to influence in an environment where paper does not directly control resources.
  • Adaptation: Ability to adapt to new circumstances in a changing business environment.
  • Customer Focus: A customer-centric approach to understanding and meeting needs effectively.
  • Languages: English and/or French are considered an asset.


Expected Skills:

  • Lead and motivate teams, demonstrating empathy.
  • Maintain a high level of expertise in IT applications and systems.
  • Oversee the integration of various IT applications to ensure operation and security.
  • Evaluate and recommend technical solutions that align with business needs.
  • Establish and manage customer expectations.
  • Develop and execute a resource plan to ensure that the right people are in the right place, doing the right things at the right time.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or equivalent. Scrum Master certification or equivalent Agile certification.
  • Education: Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Knowledge: Strong knowledge of ITIL practices. Knowledge of current and emerging technologies.

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose


The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.


⸻


Core Responsibilities


• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.


• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts .

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations , manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.


• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules .

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.


• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders , with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.


⸻


Key Qualifications


• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.


• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

• Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.

• Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

Supervisionar, coordenar e fiscalizar o funcionamento das atividades desenvolvidas no estacionamento, no que se refere a abertura e fechamento do estacionamento e dos caixas; sinalização e conservação do ambiente físico no estacionamento; atendimento a clientes; e equipes de trabalho.

Pesquisando no mercado novos equipamentos e o que mais se aplica ao perfil dos nosso clientes;

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Analista de tesouraria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Gestão do fluxo de caixa;
  • Monitoramento das contas bancárias, garantindo o equilíbrio do caixa;
  • Montagem, análise e entrega dos relatórios de caixa para os shoppings, áreas corporativas e sócios (visão realizada, projetada e indicadores);
  • Realizar operações financeiras estratégicas (aplicações, transferências, resgates, investimentos e baixas de aplicações);
  • Acompanhar a conciliação bancária.


Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Economia, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Capacidade analítica;
  • Perfil comunicativo, resiliente, proativo e investigativo;
  • Experiência em construção de análises e relatórios em Excel e Power BI.

Strong experience with quality auditing process (aeronautical authorities (FAA, ANAC, EASA), supplier qualification and aeronautical departments).

Technical degree or Graduation (Engineering, Quality or Technical) concluded with Post graduation/ master’s degree in concluded.

100% in office position at Rio de Janeiro.

title: Técnico de manutenção
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Técnico de Manutenção, você irá:


  • Ser responsável pela manutenção corretiva e preventiva, assim como solucionar os problemas diários de Guindastes;
  • Reportar e dar feedback a Sany periodicamente sobre todas as falhas e trabalhos realizados;
  • Concluir as orientações técnica e outros trabalhos emitidos pelo departamento comercial ou conforme necessidade da Sany;
  • Manter um bom relacionamento com clientes, representantes e colaboradores;
  • Elaborar relatório de Diagnóstico de falhas.


Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:


  • Ter concluído o ensino técnico em Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou áreas afins;
  • Ter experiência com manutenção em Guindastes.

  • Assistência Odontológica

  • Vale Refeição
  • Transporte

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.


Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .


Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Processos
description:

Diferenciais:

Tendo em vista o compromisso com à contratação de pessoas com deficiência e com o desenvolvimento de suas carreiras profissionais, encorajamos pessoas com deficiência a participar deste processo seletivo. Assim como profissionais pertencentes à todas as identidades e expressões de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível e origens étnico-raciais.   • Monitorar a efetividade da inclusão dos PCDs nos projetos (acompanhar adaptação, desempenho, acolhimento).
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e diagnósticos locais sobre inclusão e saúde ocupacional de PCDs.
  • Propor melhorias e ações preventivas voltadas à manutenção da saúde e segurança dos trabalhadores PCDs.
  • Garantir cumprimento das normas legais relacionadas à saúde do trabalhador e à inclusão de pessoas com deficiência (Lei de Cotas, NR-7, NR-17, entre outras).
  • Acompanhar e controlar os prestadores de serviços de saúde ocupacional (clínicas), garantindo que realizem os exames em conformidade com PCMSO vigente.

  • Conhecimento básico sobre classificações de deficiência e barreiras de acessibilidade.

title: Professor escolar
description:
A Diretoria do CSVP torna pública a abertura de inscrições e a realização do Processo Seletivo de docentes para atuação na Educação Infantil, nos anos iniciais e finais do Ensino Fundamental e no Ensino Médio, em sua sede, no Cosme Velho, por meio de prova objetiva, prática e avaliação de currículo, a ser realizado no período que se estende pelos meses de outubro e novembro.


Processo seletivo simplificado

Destina-se à formação de cadastro de candidatos para ministrar aulas presenciais aos estudantes da Educação Infantil, dos Anos Iniciais e Finais do Ensino Fundamental e do Ensino Médio do CSVP, para o ano letivo de 2026.


Requisitos:


Habilitação


Para Educação Infantil e Anos Iniciais do Ensino Fundamental, os portadores de diploma de:

a) Curso Normal Superior;

b) Licenciatura em Pedagogia / Pedagogia para atuação na Educação Infantil e Anos Iniciais do Ensino Fundamental

c) Habilitação Específica para o Magistério e Diploma do Curso Normal de Nível Médio;

d) Programa Especial de Formação Pedagógica Superior, qualquer que seja a nomenclatura do Curso, com habilitação em Magistério da Educação Infantil e dos Anos Iniciais do Ensino Fundamental.


Para Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental e Ensino Médio, os portadores de diploma de Licenciatura Plena em um dos componentes curriculares da BNCC.


No caso específico do componente curricular de Educação Física, a abertura de contrato está vinculada somente aos habilitados e à apresentação do registro no Conselho Regional de Educação Física - CREF.


Qualificação


Para Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental e Ensino Médio:

a) portadores de diploma de licenciatura plena, independentemente da existência de 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos na disciplina a ser atribuída, desde que esta seja da mesma área do conhecimento;

b) portadores de diploma de Licenciatura Curta, na área de formação acadêmica ou disciplina a ser atribuída;

c) estudantes de Licenciatura Plena, desde que apresente 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos da disciplina a ser atribuída, identificada pelo histórico do curso;

d) portadores de diploma de Bacharel ou de Tecnólogo de nível superior, desde que apresente 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos, na área de conhecimento ou disciplina a ser atribuída, identificada pelo histórico do curso;

e) estudantes de Bacharelado ou de Tecnologia de nível superior, desde que apresente 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos na área de conhecimento ou disciplina a ser atribuída, identificada pelo histórico do curso.


Inclusão e igualdade de oportunidades


Com o objetivo de promover a inclusão e a igualdade de oportunidades, o presente processo dará especial atenção para candidatos que integrem grupos historicamente marginalizados (por exemplo: pessoas com deficiência – PcD −, indígenas, mulheres, negros, pessoas incluídas no acrônimo LGBTQIAPN+, idosos.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Organizacional Pleno

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

description:
The Planner applies existing knowledge and experience in the Planning/Scheduling discipline to support routine assignments. They will use best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve products or services in the Planning/Scheduling discipline.


Job Overview:

The Planner applies their conceptual knowledge of Planning/Scheduling and, with a moderate level of guidance and direction from colleagues and leadership, is responsible for solving a range of straightforward Planning/Scheduling problems. They will be responsible for analyzing practical solutions using standard procedures and building knowledge of the company, processes, and customers. The Planner understands key business drivers and applies this knowledge to solve problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using technical experience, judgment, and precedents.


Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain logically linked level 3 and level 4 activity EPFCIC schedules, for offshore and onshore projects in the Oil and Gas Industry, according to precedence flow diagrams, using best practices and under the supervision of Senior Planners
  • Produce workforce histograms and progress and quantity curves in connection with the schedules
  • Maintain and review the sequence of Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, Construction, Installation, Hook-Up, and Commissioning, and other operations for control of critical path and overall project durations
  • Elevate and expedite operations that are delaying the schedule and analyze changes to the schedule to meet unforeseen conditions
  • Prepare lists of required resources, materials, tools, and equipment for input into Work Packages
  • In-depth knowledge of advanced work package principles and management
  • Develop, resource load, level, and update activities in alignment with earned value management systems


Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Associate’s Degree or Bachelor's Degree in Project Management/Engineering/Construction/Business Management or equivalent combinations of technical training or experience required
  • 5-7 years of project planning experience with offshore or onshore oil and gas-related projects
  • Must have a solid command of Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project
  • Must be able to use advanced features in Excel (curves, histograms, dynamic tables, formulas, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Primavera P6 and its interaction with other software and disciplines
  • Ability to mentor junior members of the team and deliver functional training
  • Understand how to use the information available to satisfy data requests
  • Analyze and provide additional insight or correlations within data sets
  • Analyze projects based on historical data and current trends to provide project insights
  • Ability to think critically, solve problems, and display attentiveness to detail

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The role will be a key management and coordination point ensuring business and technical requirements are accurately captured, dependencies are met, and solutions are efficiently and effectively delivered and adopted across the enterprise. We support project teams and squads that deliver with excellence.


Key responsibilities:


- Guide teams in mastering Scrum practices for effective execution.

- Lead Scrum events, enhancing collaboration and transparency.

- Collaborate with Product Owners to refine backlog priorities.

- Remove obstacles to boost quality deliverables.

- Cultivate continuous improvement and best practices.

- Foster self-organization and positive teamwork.

- Ensure adherence to values and sustainable pace.

- Align with Scrum Masters and stakeholders for synergy.


Requirements:


- More than three years of experience as a Scrum Master.

- More than four years of experience in the IT industry.

- Master Jira and Confluence tools to drive efficiency.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Fluent Spanish level.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Golang Developer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who thrives in building scalable, high-impact solutions and who seeks to influence not just technology but also the direction of the product. You’re looking for a company where innovation and ownership go hand in hand, and where your contributions directly shape outcomes.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in full-stack development with a focus on Next.js, Go, and MySQL .
  • Strong expertise in AWS services including ECS Fargate, CloudWatch, RDS, S3, and IAM.
  • Proven background in data engineering, data workflow architecture, and pipeline development .
  • Hands-on experience managing end-to-end product delivery (CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, DevOps, DBA tasks).
  • Familiarity with Geo Spatial Data, AdTech, and Online Advertising platforms .
  • Demonstrated experience with performance optimization, diagnosing bottlenecks, and implementing preventive measures .
  • Ability to clearly communicate about complex technical and organizational problems, and to propose iterative, actionable solutions.
  • Comfortable working in iterative/agile development environments with frequent releases.
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and provide transparent status updates.
  • Self-motivated and organized, with experience owning projects from concept to production .
  • Nice-to-haves: Python, Rust, Metabase, ForestAdmin, Jira, Confluence .
  • Proficiency in English, as the role requires direct communication with US-based teams and stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deliver features and improvements to the product suite in a secure, well-tested, and performant way.
  • Collaborate with management, engineers, and stakeholders to uphold quality and delivery standards in a fast-paced, iterative environment.
  • Advocate for and implement improvements to product quality, scalability, performance, and security.
  • Solve technical problems of moderate to high complexity, proposing and delivering sustainable solutions.
  • Write and maintain clean, maintainable, and scalable code, ensuring consistency across the codebase.
  • Conduct code reviews and help establish and reinforce coding best practices.
  • Identify and address technical debt and propose improvements to team efficiency.
  • Take ownership of projects, shipping features and improvements with minimal guidance while collaborating on larger initiatives.


Qualifications

  • Go, MySQL
  • AWS ECS Fargate, CloudWatch, RDS, S3, IAM
  • Data workflows, pipelines, and architecture
  • RESTful APIs and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
  • Performance optimization and debugging in production environments
  • Geo Spatial Data, AdTech, and Online Advertising experience


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Advogado Especialista em Contratos - Especialista
description:

Dedicação exclusiva conforme disposto no Art. 20 da lei Nº 8.906 , de 04 de Julho de 1994 – Estatuto da OAB

title: Arquiteto de redes
description:
Arquiteto de Redes Core

Início Imediato

Contrato CLT (Projeto de 6 meses)

Local: Rio de Janeiro/RJ – Híbrido (3x por semana presencial)

Horário Comercial

Idioma: Inglês Avançado (obrigatório)


Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Redes Core altamente qualificado(a) e estratégico(a) para um projeto com duração de 6 meses. Esta é uma posição sênior , com foco em fornecer orientações especializadas de rede para o cliente. Você atuará como um consultor técnico de confiança, traduzindo necessidades complexas em soluções de alto nível que sustentam uma operação empresarial robusta e diversificada.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenho de Soluções para o Cliente : Responsável pelo design arquitetônico de projetos relacionados a redes. Isso inclui o desenvolvimento e a apresentação de soluções de rede completas, alinhadas às necessidades de uma empresa global de bens de consumo, com sedes corporativas, fábricas, centros de distribuição e lojas. O foco está na estratégia e arquitetura de alto nível — não na implementação ou configuração.
  • Suporte a RFPs e Negócios : Atuar como especialista técnico em redes durante processos de RFP (Request for Proposal), elaborando propostas técnicas detalhadas, modelos de custo e apresentando soluções para as áreas técnica e executiva do cliente.
  • Consultoria Técnica Estratégica : Ser um conselheiro técnico confiável para a LOREAL , orientando sobre estratégias de rede, seleção de tecnologias e melhores práticas. Garantir que as soluções estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de longo prazo da empresa, como transformação digital, e-commerce e otimização da cadeia de suprimentos global.
  • Conhecimento Multicamadas : Fornecer liderança arquitetônica em todas as camadas da rede — desde a Camada 1 (física) , incluindo fibra óptica, até Camadas 2 e 3 (switching, roteamento e protocolos). Ter experiência com redes que suportam grandes volumes de dados, vídeo e sensores IoT é altamente desejável.
  • Colaboração Global : Trabalhar de forma eficaz com times distribuídos globalmente, garantindo execução fluida dos projetos e comunicação clara.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência : 10+ anos em engenharia e arquitetura de redes, com histórico comprovado em projetos de grande escala para clientes corporativos. Preferência para experiência nos setores de bens de consumo, varejo ou manufatura .
  • RFPs : Experiência prévia com suporte técnico em RFPs empresariais, incluindo elaboração de designs técnicos, modelos de custos e documentação de propostas.
  • Conhecimento Técnico Profundo : Compreensão avançada das camadas de rede:
  • Camada 1 : Fibra óptica, DWDM;
  • Camada 2 : Ethernet, switching;
  • Camada 3 : Roteamento IP, BGP, OSPF.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação : Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos em linguagem clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Visão Estratégica : Experiência comprovada em cargos estratégicos e não operacionais, com foco em design de alto nível e governança.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente : Vivência anterior em posições de contato direto com o cliente, atuando como conselheiro técnico.
  • Certificações : Certificações relevantes como CCIE ou outras reconhecidas na área de arquitetura e design de redes são um diferencial.


Mais informações serão fornecidas durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Assistente de Logística Pleno
description:
Assistente de Logística Pleno


Empresa: Zeiki Medical


Localização: Barra da Tijuca – Rio de Janeiro/RJ (presencial)

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!


About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.


Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.



Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient


Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.


A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.


More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

title: Assistente Jurídico Trabalhista | Vaga Exclusiva para PcD
description:

Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.


Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .


Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio

title: Recepcionista Bilíngue

title: Técnico de manutenção
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Técnico de Manutenção, você irá:

  • Ser responsável pela manutenção corretiva e preventiva, assim como solucionar os problemas diários de Guindastes;
  • Reportar e dar feedback a Sany periodicamente sobre todas as falhas e trabalhos realizados;
  • Concluir as orientações técnica e outros trabalhos emitidos pelo departamento comercial ou conforme necessidade da Sany;
  • Manter um bom relacionamento com clientes, representantes e colaboradores;
  • Elaborar relatório de Diagnóstico de falhas.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Ter concluído o ensino técnico em Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou áreas afins;
  • Ter experiência com manutenção em Guindastes.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.

· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.

· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.

· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.

· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;

o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.

o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose

The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

⸻

Core Responsibilities

• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts .

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations , manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.

• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules .

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.

• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders , with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

⸻

Key Qualifications

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.

• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

• Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.

• Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

description:
Responsibilities：

Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases.

Manage local system integration projects to ensure effective implementation of solutions as guided by headquarters' technical requirements, while optimizing execution according to local needs.

Develop and implement localized IT solutions. Ensure IT infrastructure maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards.

Monitor the quality of office network using tools provided by headquarters IT, gather user feedback, and design and implement corresponding improvements.

Track, manage, and Inventory local IT infrastructure resources (including equipment inventories and supplier collaboration) and resolve local application and service issues, and ensure the integrity of IT infrastructure.

Coordinate local service provider resources to ensure rapid problem resolution and efficient use of personnel, equipment, and time to meet project needs effectively.

Provide standard operating procedures and documentation support, regularly reporting progress on localized solutions to headquarters.

Requirements：

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.

At least 3 years of experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance.

Familiarity with enterprise-level network architecture and equipment management. Knowledge of routing protocols such as Static Routing, OSPF, and BGP; VPN technologies including GRE, SSL VPN, and IPSec VPN; and wireless authentication protocols like EAP, PEAP, and TLS.

Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.g. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools.

Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.

Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses.

Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.

Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.

Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Arabic and English, for effective communication is preferred.

Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.g. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.g. PMP) is an advantage.

title: Quality and Engineering Specialist
description:
About us:

DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.

About the job:

The Specialist in the Quality and Engineering department is a highly experienced professional who takes a leadership role in quality management and technical reference. They are responsible for overseeing and directing high complex quality control processes, leading strategic improvements, and ensuring the company’s adherence to industry’s best practices and regulatory requirements.

  • Technical guidance for analysts, ensuring compliance with internal procedures, manuals and best practices.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including operations, supply chain and planning to ensure seamless quality management.
  • Support internal and external audits, providing technical support and assistance during regulatory inspections and certifications.
  • Develop and report on key quality performance indicators, identifying areas for process optimization and cost reduction.
  • Be the technical reference in strategic decision-making regarding quality and process improvements.

Work Experience:

+5 Years of experience working in an aeronautical industry with quality and/or engineering.

Strong experience with quality auditing process (aeronautical authorities (FAA, ANAC, EASA), supplier qualification and aeronautical departments).

Educational:

Technical degree or Graduation (Engineering, Quality or Technical) concluded with Post graduation/ master’s degree in concluded.

Advanced / Fluent English is mandatory

Technical Skills:

Advanced quality tools, drawing interpretations (development is a plus), in-depth knowledge of aeronautical authorities’ regulations (FAA, EASA, ANAC) and ISO 9001 standard or related audit standard requirements.

Obs.: Office and shop floor setting in a regulated aerospace maintenance facility.

May require occasional hands-on inspections or shop visits involving PPE and exposure to aircraft components and tooling.

Work may involve tight deadlines and collaboration across departments.

Location:

100% in office position at Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Job Description

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Knowledge of SOC2 compliance standards and security best practices.
  • Experience with VPN configuration, Cloud IdP (such as JumpCloud), and network security.

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation tools (e.g., Python, Bash) is desirable.
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and container orchestration.
  • Advanced english proficiency.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Infrastructure Management: Manage both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure seamless operations.
  • VPN Configuration & Management: Configure and manage VPN access to secure connections for employees.
  • Cloud Identity Provider (IdP) Management: Oversee JumpCloud or equivalent cloud IDP services for secure user management.
  • Employee Onboarding & Offboarding: Manage workstation setups, configurations, and removals during employee transitions.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement, manage, and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform for streamlined infrastructure deployment.
  • AWS Account & IAM Management: Oversee AWS IAM roles, permissions, and account setups for both employees and applications.
  • Database Cluster Management: Scale and manage database clusters and connectivity using AWS RDS, ensuring high availability and performance.

  • Monitoring & Alerting: Design and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems with Datadog to ensure proactive issue detection and resolution.
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient, reliable, and secure deployment processes.
  • SOC2 Compliance: Ensure all company data systems meet SOC2 standards and regularly review for compliance adherence.
  • Information and Network Security: Establish, enforce, and enhance network security measures, following industry best practices.
  • Penetration Testing & Audits: Conduct recurring penetration tests and audits as per company policies, addressing vulnerabilities promptly.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Ser responsável por conduzir e qualificar processos de performance, feedback e PDI, traduzindo dados em indicadores estratégicos que orientem decisões da alta liderança. Apoiar gestores e diretoria como parceiro de confiança, conectando iniciativas de desenvolvimento, diversidade e engajamento à estratégia corporativa, com maturidade, visão crítica e autonomia para sustentar a transformação cultural da organização.

  • Acompanhar e garantir feedback de desenvolvimento dos gestores;

  • Mapa de Sucessão com nível de prontidão, com estruturação de agendas de retenção talentos e para as posições chaves;
  • Apoiar e conduzir localmente as ações de desenvolvimento dos programas corporativos: Mentoria, coaching executivo, ações internacionais, etc.;

  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

description:
A Origem Energia

Nosso propósito é contribuir para o desenvolvimento do Brasil por meio da integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades: Atuar na gestão do planejamento tático operacional de atividades de manutenção e outras realizadas no ativo, assegurando a execução eficiente das atividades, o monitoramento de cronogramas e recursos, a análise de indicadores de desempenho e a proposição de melhorias nos processos de planejamento.

6. Interface com todas as áreas da empresa, promovendo comunicação fluida e alinhamento contínuo com as diretrizes estratégicas.

7. Elaboração de apresentações gerenciais e executivas periódicas, com foco em andamento, resultados e projeções.

Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.

  • Acompanhar auditoria diária dos quiosques, através da agenda de visitas dos consultores e reporte do Supervisor, para conferência do cumprimento dos contratos.
  • Elaborar relatórios de controle operacional mensal ou mediante demanda elencando todas as atividades e resultados do departamento, incluindo evidências fotográficas de status dos quiosques se necessário, enviando os dados para acompanhamento pela diretoria.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com outros departamentos (Atendimento ao Cliente, Manutenção, Auditoria, Postos e Bases, Comercial, Merchandising) conforme agendamento mensal, semanal ou de urgência específica, para alinhamento de andamento de processos, troca de ideias, resolução de problemas e definição de planos de ação.
  • Realizar estudo de viabilidade de novos produtos e/ou parceiros, analisando juntamente com o departamento de atendimento ao cliente, visando trazer maiores resultados aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar relatórios sanitários, conforme reporte da equipe de sanitaristas, para monitoramento das atividades realizadas e do desempenho de cada quiosque.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com novos operadores, através de agendamento prévio, visando alinhamento de execução do plano de ação inicial operacional onde são dispostas as principais demandas e obrigatoriedades do operador.
  • Garantir cadastro de novos clientes efetuando o processo junto aos operadores via sistema Check List, para obter os dados necessários para firmar novos parceiros e ações.
  • Acompanhar equipe nas inaugurações e entrega de quiosques, por meio de visitas agendadas com operadores e departamentos responsáveis, garantindo o preenchimento de relatórios e termos pertinentes, a fim de criar comunicação efetiva com o cliente e garantir a qualidade das entregas.
  • Atuar junto à equipe nas devoluções de quiosques, por meio de visitas agendadas com o operador e departamento de Manutenção, assegurando o preenchimento de checklist de vistoria e o termo de devolução de posse assinado, para documentar o estado do quiosque na data, bem como obter evidências para realizar cobrança de itens que não estiverem em conformidade.
  • Fechar penalidades de todos os contratos que geram receita para a empresa, via sistema Totvs, para que o financeiro faça o fechamento contábil das receitas da empresa.
  • Cadastrar amarração de contratos Ambev via sistema Totvs, para identificação dos clientes correspondentes para posterior fechamento de penalidades (auxiliando o departamento Jurídico), para garantir que o setor Financeiro efetue o fechamento contábil da referida empresa.
  • Promover reuniões/treinamentos mensais a equipe, abordando temas como: comunicação, relacionamento com cliente e ética profissional, visando orientar e desenvolver para obter melhor performance dos colaboradores e uma gestão mais eficiente.
  • Promover a integração entre os operadores e a empresa, realizando reuniões semanais, visando manter um relacionamento de feedback essencial para proporcionar melhoria na prestação de serviços.
  • Coordenar implantação dos projetos, montagem e execução de operações externas, realizando estudo da viabilidade através da análise do objetivo do cliente, visando garantir entregas de qualidade para os operadores.
  • Acompanhar auditoria e controle financeiro do Contrato Souza Cruz, realizando acompanhamento das vendas, levantamento e cobrança aos operadores das dívidas e envio de fechamento mensal do contrato, para cumprimento das cláusulas contratuais da parceria comercial.
  • Elaborar relatórios semanais de acompanhamento de obras, através das fotos enviadas pela equipe e contato com os operadores e demais setores, para monitorar a execução de obras nos quiosques.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharias, Publicidade e Propagando ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência entre 3 a 5 anos na área comercial;
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar em campo;
  • Ter CNH B;
  • Ter experiência com o sistema Totvs.

Diferenciais:

  • Ter atuado em rede de franquias;
  • Perfil voltado para a área comercial;
  • Expertise em análise de performance contratual;
  • Ter experiência com consultoria de franquias.

Escala e local de trabalho:

Segunda à sexta-feira – 8h às 17:48 (Com 1h de almoço) | Zona Sul.

title: Communications Specialist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Communications Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career.

Job Description:

The Communication Specialist plays a vital role in managing and enhancing the communication channels within the IT department and between IT and other departments. The role involves creating, implementing, and maintaining effective communication strategies to promote clarity and efficiency in the dissemination of information. In addition, the specialist will translate complex technical aspects into content that is easy for the user to understand.

Mandatory Skills (3 to max 5):

  • Content Development: Develop and maintain IT communication materials, such as technical documentation, user manuals, FAQs, and newsletters.
  • Project Management and Leadership: Lead projects and communication initiatives of the IT department, from planning to execution and evaluation. Manage a team of junior communication specialists.
  • Strategy and Continuous Improvement: Develop and implement performance metrics to assess the effectiveness of communication strategies. Conduct regular systems audits and user feedback sessions to identify areas for improvement in communication tools.
  • Technical Support and Tools: Provide technical support and troubleshooting for communication tools, ensuring minimal downtime9. Use communication tools such as SharePoint, Slack, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams.
  • Coordination and Collaboration: Act as a liaison between the IT department and other departments. Coordinate with multiple teams to ensure consistency and accuracy of information.
  • Administration and Documentation: Maintain records of communications and feedback. Prepare regular reports on the effectiveness of communication to senior management.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in IT communications or a related field.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Communication or related field.
  • Tool Proficiency: Knowledge of content management systems (CMS) and document management systems. Ability to use graphic design tools, such as Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Languages: English and/or French are considered an asset.

Soft Skills:

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills19. Strong ability to influence and communicate.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Leadership: Proven experience in managing communication strategies and projects22. Ability to lead and guide a team.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master’s degree in information technology, Communication or related field.
  • Certifications: Certifications in project management or communication-related fields.
  • Knowledge: Experience in multimedia content creation and graphic design.
  • Knowledge of best practices and emerging trends in IT communications.

title: Application Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Application Project Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.

Job Description:

The Application Project Manager will drive the delivery and management of IT applications throughout their lifecycle. This role is essential to ensure the effectiveness, security and innovation of the applications, contributing to the overall technological advancement and operational efficiency of the organization. The professional must possess a distinct combination of business, IT, financial, and communication skills.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Project Management: Developing detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Ensure the timely and successful delivery of IT projects, meeting defined goals and expectations.
  • Leadership and People Management: Lead and inspire project teams, promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Provide support, guidance, and mentorship to team members, encouraging their professional growth.
  • Stakeholder Management: Developing and maintaining strong relationships with all project stakeholders, ensuring that their needs and expectations are understood and managed effectively.
  • Resource Management and Budget: Allocate and manage resources effectively to ensure project delivery within scope, deadline, and budget constraints. Develop and manage the project budget, seeking to optimize expenses and minimize the total cost of ownership.
  • Supplier and Contract Management: Collaborate and negotiate with suppliers, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure successful completion.
  • Quality Assurance and Compliance: Implement rigorous testing and quality assurance protocols. Ensure that all project activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, and organizational policies.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 11 to 15 years of experience. More than 10 years of experience in IT project management with a focus on application development and deployment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Tools: Proficiency in project management software such as MS Project, Jira, Trello . Knowledge of reporting and analysis tools to track metrics and project performance.
  • Methodologies: Familiarity with project management methodologies such as PMI, PRINCE2 and Agile approaches.

Soft Skills:

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Leadership: Strong leadership qualities to guide and motivate teams.
  • Conflict Resolution: Proficiency in identifying and resolving conflicts through effective mediation and negotiation techniques.
  • Negotiation Skill and Influence: Effective negotiation skills for dealing with contracts. Ability to influence in an environment where paper does not directly control resources.
  • Adaptation: Ability to adapt to new circumstances in a changing business environment.
  • Customer Focus: A customer-centric approach to understanding and meeting needs effectively.
  • Languages: English and/or French are considered an asset.

Expected Skills:

  • Lead and motivate teams, demonstrating empathy.
  • Maintain a high level of expertise in IT applications and systems.
  • Oversee the integration of various IT applications to ensure operation and security.
  • Evaluate and recommend technical solutions that align with business needs.
  • Establish and manage customer expectations.
  • Develop and execute a resource plan to ensure that the right people are in the right place, doing the right things at the right time.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or equivalent. Scrum Master certification or equivalent Agile certification.
  • Education: Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Knowledge: Strong knowledge of ITIL practices. Knowledge of current and emerging technologies.
